narrative: A fresh black-letter bill pasted on the Bishopsgate post, the paste still dark at its edges. Title only, no author's name and no sum. A second fresh bill on the same post, a hand's breadth lower. Title only.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read both bills and walked on.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on bill in Two bills on the Bishopsgate post
